title: Ph.D. Research Program Admission
about: Mid-year research PhD admission at the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, for the session starting January 2027. International candidates apply through the Office of International Relations; the application window runs October 6-26, 2026.
requirements: International candidates (foreign nationals with a foreign passport) apply through the Office of International Relations

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Science and engineering research" (field) -> "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"PhD applicants" (level) -> "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
Note: the record lists no technical requirements (only the international application route); the match is to the field and research level, not to a stated skill.

card_alt: Card for the Ph.D. Research Program Admission at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, India, with an application deadline of 26 Oct 2026.
